body.faq_description: Common questions about custom software development, timelines, technology and ongoing support.

faqs.question: What is custom software development?
faqs.answer: Custom software development is the process of designing and building applications tailored to your business workflows, data and growth goals. Unlike off-the-shelf tools, custom software fits how your team operates and can evolve with your business.

faqs.question: When should I choose custom software over off-the-shelf tools?
faqs.answer: Custom software makes sense when existing products force workarounds, create data silos, limit integrations or cannot scale with your operations. If your competitive advantage depends on unique workflows or a proprietary platform, bespoke development is often the better long-term investment.

faqs.question: What types of custom software does IGENTX build?
faqs.answer: We build customer and admin portals, internal dashboards, workflow automation tools, API integrations, SaaS platforms and vertical products. Examples include childcare management platforms, client portals and operational tools for growing businesses.

faqs.question: How long does a custom software project take?
faqs.answer: Timelines depend on scope. Focused internal tools or MVPs often take 4-8 weeks. Larger platforms with multiple roles, integrations and billing may take 8-16 weeks. We provide a realistic timeline after discovery based on features, integrations and content readiness.

faqs.question: What technology stack do you use?
faqs.answer: We typically use Next.js, React, TypeScript and modern cloud infrastructure on AWS or Vercel. Integrations are API-first, with headless CMS, payment gateways and third-party services connected as needed for your product.

faqs.question: Can you integrate with our existing systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate with CRMs, ERPs, payment providers, marketing tools and internal databases through REST APIs, webhooks and documented integration patterns. Connecting your stack is often a core part of custom software projects.

faqs.question: Do you provide maintenance after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer ongoing support covering security updates, performance monitoring, feature iterations and integration changes. Support can be scoped as ad-hoc hours or a monthly retainer with agreed response times.

faqs.question: Do you work with startups and enterprises?
faqs.answer: Yes. For startups we focus on fast MVP delivery with foundations that scale. For enterprises we emphasise architecture, security, integrations and phased rollouts. Our process adapts to your team size, budget and timeline.
